en.quote: And he said unto me, Son of man, cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee. Then did I eat it; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.
en.riddle: cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll
en.speaker: He

he.quote: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי בֶּן-אָדָם בִּטְנְךָ תַאֲכֵל וּמֵעֶיךָ תְמַלֵּא, אֵת הַמְּגִלָּה הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר אֲנִי נֹתֵן אֵלֶיךָ וָאֹכְלָה וַתְּהִי בְּפִי כִּדְבַשׁ לְמָתֽוֹק
he.riddle: בִּטְנְךָ תַאֲכֵל וּמֵעֶיךָ תְמַלֵּא, אֵת הַמְּגִלָּה הַזֹּאת
he.speaker: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי

en.quote: But when I speak with thee, I will open thy mouth, and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; he that heareth, let him hear, and he that forbeareth, let him forbear: for they are a rebellious house.
en.riddle: he that heareth, let him hear, and he that forbeareth, let him forbear
en.speaker: LORD

he.quote: וּֽבְדַבְּרִי אֽוֹתְךָ אֶפְתַּח אֶת-פִּיךָ וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵיהֶם כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהֹוִה הַשֹּׁמֵעַ יִשְׁמָע וְהֶחָדֵל יֶחְדָּל כִּי בֵּית מְרִי הֵֽמָּה
he.speaker: אֲדֹנָי
